query: What concrete, implementable changes to the SAD (Stakeholder-Anchored Development) v0.1 methodology repository (C:/SAD) would most lower the activation energy for a first-time adopter — solo developer, small team, or maintainer of an existing repo — to start using SAD on a real project, while preserving SAD's central novelty (the three-tier audience model in NOVEL.md §1 and the Reconcile-as-numbered-phase invariant in NOVEL.md §2)? Specifically: (a) which artifacts in the current kit (1357-line user guide, 20 commands, bash-only scripts, descriptive hooks) raise the time-to-first-observable-win the most; (b) what shape of progressive disclosure (quickstart, cheatsheet, installer, worked examples beyond the single CRUD example) is consistent with published 2025-2026 evidence on developer-methodology adoption; (c) how should SAD adapt when the three human tiers collapse to one solo developer without collapsing into spec theatre; and (d) which integration-with-AI-coding-assistant patterns (Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Codex, Windsurf) ship as turn-key adapters rather than as 'six abstract integration patterns the user must implement themselves' per SAD_USER_GUIDE.md §8.6?
context: SAD v0.1 is an OSS methodology kit at C:/SAD: Markdown-first, MIT-licensed, ~20 reference docs, ~20 slash-command prompts, ~20 agent personas, 4 eval-suite skeletons, 5 descriptive hook JSON files, 4 bash helper scripts, 1 worked example. README routes immediately to a 1357-line user guide; no QUICKSTART, no CHEATSHEET, no installer, no cross-platform scripts, no turn-key assistant adapters, no Level-0 maturity entry for solo devs. The methodology's central novel claim (per NOVEL.md) is the three-tier stakeholder audience model — that protection should not be lost in any accessibility change.
custom_instructions: Each idea must (1) name at least one concrete file or directory in C:/SAD that it would touch, (2) state a smallest-PR next step, and (3) include a falsifiable adoption signal — an observable metric that would tell the SAD maintainers within 90 days whether the change actually moved time-to-first-observable-win. Cite at least one 2025-2026 external source per non-trivial idea where prior art exists (developer-methodology onboarding, AI-coding-assistant integration, spec-driven development adoption). Preserve the three-tier audience model and the Reconcile phase invariant; ideas that erode either are out of scope.
